Container.Name: executor
Container.Overview: Unofficial Unraid template for Executor, a self-hosted integration layer for AI agents.
Container.Description:
Executor lets AI agents use your apps and accounts through one MCP endpoint, with approvals for sensitive calls.
This template uses the official Executor self-host Docker image. Executor v2 starts with fresh data; it does not read Executor v1 data.
Unraid-specific notes: - Persistent app data is mapped to /app/data. - Set BETTER_AUTH_URL to the exact public URL when using a reverse proxy, domain, or TLS. - The first person to finish setup becomes the owner.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent app data. Executor stores its database, app builds, and generated keys here. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Exact public URL users open, for example https://executor.example.com. Browser sign-in fails if the scheme, host, or port differ. Defaults to http://localhost:4400.

Config.Name: Allow Private Network
Config.Description: Let app code reach private network addresses, such as LAN services. Every app shares this access. Leave false unless you need it.

Config.Name: App Catalog URL
Config.Description: index.json of the app feed that Add app lists. Leave empty to list only the built-in Executor app.

Config.Name: OAuth Client Metadata URL
Config.Description: Set to your Public URL plus /oauth/client-metadata.json so services that accept client ID metadata documents can identify Executor. It must be reachable publicly over HTTPS.
